description: This file defines interfaces for grain call filters in the Orleans framework, specifically for incoming and outgoing grain call filtering.

classes.name: IIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for incoming grain call filters, allowing custom logic to be executed during incoming grain calls.

classes.name: IOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for outgoing grain call filters, allowing custom logic to be executed during outgoing grain calls.
